name: GTT Data Solutions Limited
about: GTT Data Solutions Limited provides services to manufacturing, industrial products, and medical devices technology to develop and build products, processes, and infrastructure in India and internationally. The company operates the through Training and IT services segments. It offers AI solutions and digital engineering, such as consulting and digital transformation, data engineering, analytics, enterprise AI, DevOps/ITSM, ERP/CRM, and managed/outsourcing services; and human intelligence training and workforce development, including AI model development and data science skills; cloud, software dev/test; ERP; human-digital collaboration, leadership for the AI era, culture change, and dual-intelligence-ready talent initiatives. The company was formerly known as Cinerad Communications Limited and changed its name to GTT Data Solutions Limited in January 2025. GTT Data Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Pune, India.
